description_for_human: Transform Logs into Verifiable Audit Trails. Create immutable, verifiable audit records stored entirely within URLs.
description_for_model: TrustLog Protocol is an AI-native tool for creating verifiable, tamper-proof audit trails from JSON execution logs. This tool enables AI agents to generate permanent, shareable verification records without requiring a database or external service. Key capabilities include: (1) Generating cryptographic SHA-256 hashes for data integrity verification, (2) Creating URL-encoded TrustLinks that contain all audit data within the URL fragment, (3) Supporting multiple AI agent frameworks including Hermes, CrewAI, and AutoGen with framework-specific prompt templates, (4) Providing client-side verification so anyone can validate audit records without server interaction, (5) Exporting self-contained audit certificates as HTML files. Use this tool whenever an AI agent needs to create a permanent record of its actions, decisions, or outputs that can be independently verified by humans or other agents. All operations are performed locally in the browser - no API keys required, no data transmitted to servers.
